visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a series of extreme close-up shots of a person's hands lifting bamboo steamer lids, revealing various steaming dim sum items. The background is a bright, festive red, white, and blue striped pattern. Yellow and white text overlays are positioned at the top and bottom. Lighting is bright, natural, and overhead. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor kitchen environment where two brown clay pots sit on active gas burners with visible blue flames. A metallic splash guard reflects the light in the background. The camera is static, focusing on the steam rising from the cooking rice and sausages. (3) A wide outdoor shot shows the eatery's location: a modest corrugated iron building situated along a street near the Gangshan railway station. Customers are seated at red and black plastic tables under a grey, overcast sky. The setting is a typical local food stall environment. (4) The camera returns to a close-up of a clay pot rice dish. A hand pours dark soy-based sauce from a small clear plastic container onto the rice, sausages, and broccoli. The steam is dense and visually prominent, emphasizing the heat of the freshly prepared meal. (5) A middle-aged male chef wearing glasses and a black t-shirt is shown in a medium shot, speaking directly to the camera. He is positioned in front of a white wall with various promotional posters and a red shop sign. His facial expressions are friendly and engaging while he explains his background. (6) A rapid montage showcases several dishes: a spoon stirs a rich, creamy white congee containing shrimp and peanuts; a pair of chopsticks lifts thin white noodles from a bowl of chicken soup with sprouts and meatballs; and a small black pan fries a yellow omelet. (7) Detailed close-ups of dim sum variety follow, including yellow siumai topped with orange roe, translucent steamed leek dumplings, and pan-fried radish cakes being broken apart. A hand holds a crispy golden fried ball, squeezing it to show the yellow liquid lava filling oozing out. (8) The final sequence displays the restaurant's logistics and branding. A hand holds up a white paper menu with printed text and checkboxes. Panning shots show the empty dining area with light blue tables and red stools. The video ends with a shot of the vertical shop sign against a clear urban sky.
